properties.name: shelf_shoaling
properties.why: 100 m across the shoaling band. Deeper than -30 m is outside create_active anyway; shallower than -8 m is picked up by the surf gate at 25 m.

properties.name: inland_floodplain
properties.why: 100 m on inland ground so land steps 50 -> 100 -> 200 m rather than jumping two levels at once, which makes a visible stair in the flood edge.

properties.name: bay_water
properties.why: 50 m over Raritan / Lower / Sandy Hook Bay — the water this domain exists to COMPUTE. The working resolution for the interior.

properties.name: coastal_corridor
properties.why: 50 m along the Monmouth coastal strip, matching v1's working resolution so the open coast stays comparable between the two domains.

properties.name: narrows_cut
properties.why: 25 m across the Verrazzano Narrows: ~1.9 km / 25 m = ~76 cells carrying the Upper Bay + Hudson tidal prism. This cut IS the measurement (crs flux), so it is the one place resolution is not negotiable.

properties.name: arthur_kill_cut
properties.why: 25 m across the Arthur Kill mouth: ~1.46 km / 25 m = ~58 cells.

properties.name: surf_dune
properties.why: 25 m in the surf zone, foredune and barrier. Gated -8..+3 m so it cannot reach back into the bay, which shares part of that depth band.

properties.name: shrewsbury_navesink
properties.why: 25 m through the behind-barrier estuaries — the conveyance test, and the basin where a throttled inlet has twice been mistaken for a boundary problem.

properties.name: bay_fringe
properties.why: 25 m on the bay MARGIN only. The band is the whole point: the bay interior is deeper than -1 m so it stays at 50 m, and only shoreline, marsh and mudflat — where wetting is threshold-nonlinear — are refined.
